lines.cap: In 1957, sixty of America's biggest mob bosses got caught with their pants down. In the woods. In very expensive suits.
lines.say: In 1957, sixty of America's biggest mob bosses got caught with their pants down. In the woods. In very expensive suits.

lines.cap: November 1957. Apalachin, a tiny village in New York. Mafia bosses from all over America meet at a farmhouse. A mob summit.
lines.say: November 1957. Apalachin, a tiny village in New York. Mafia bosses from all over America meet at a farmhouse. A mob summit.

lines.cap: But a local state trooper notices something. Dozens of shiny Cadillacs, in a village of farmers.
lines.say: But a local state trooper notices something. Dozens of shiny Cadillacs, in a village of farmers.

lines.cap: He sets up a roadblock. And the most feared men in America panic.
lines.say: He sets up a roadblock. And the most feared men in America panic.

lines.cap: They sprint into the woods. In silk suits and polished shoes. Through mud, thorns and barbed wire.
lines.say: They sprint into the woods. In silk suits and polished shoes. Through mud, thorns and barbed wire.

lines.cap: Police catch around sixty of them. Their excuse? They were all just visiting a sick friend.
lines.say: Police catch around sixty of them. Their excuse? They were all just visiting a sick friend.

lines.cap: And here's the dark part. For years, the head of the FBI had insisted the Mafia didn't even exist.
lines.say: And here's the dark part. For years, the head of the FBI had insisted the Mafia didn't even exist.

lines.cap: That afternoon in the mud proved him wrong.
